description: Implementation of the gl::Buffer class, managing OpenGL buffer objects including data storage, mapping, copying, and state management.

classes.name: BufferState
classes.description: Holds the internal state of a buffer, including label, usage, size, access flags, mapping status, and binding counts.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL buffer object, providing methods for data management, mapping, copying, and state notifications.

methods.name: Buffer::setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the buffer object.

methods.name: Buffer::getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the buffer object.

methods.name: Buffer::bufferData
methods.description: Creates and initializes buffer data store.

methods.name: Buffer::bufferSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data store.

methods.name: Buffer::map
methods.description: Maps the buffer's data store for writing.

methods.name: Buffer::mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer's data store for writing.

methods.name: Buffer::onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when buffer data changes.

methods.name: Buffer::getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing, using cache if available.

methods.name: Buffer::getMemorySize
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the buffer.

methods.name: Buffer::isDoubleBoundForTransformFeedback
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is bound for transform feedback more than once.

methods.name: Buffer::onTFBindingChanged
methods.description: Updates binding counts when the buffer's transform feedback binding state changes.

methods.name: Buffer::onSubjectStateChange
methods.description: Handles notifications of state changes from the implementation.
